belief_update: I think people would see me as less capable if they knew how much I need reassurance, so I hide it at work even when it feels like it's costing me. With my sister and boyfriend, I let some of it show but still hold back most of it, afraid it might make them think I'm not okay. I don't talk about it much because I don't want to be seen as weak or unreliable. Sometimes I wonder if I'm really meant for this job or if I'm just holding on by chance. I don't know if this is who I am or just something temporary that's happening to me. I keep most of it away, but I don't know if that means I'm not worth anything or just hiding until I figure it out.
